documents.title: RCA for INC4841815 (Account Merge Issue)
documents.issue_description: (US) - MDM team reported Multiple Account AFDs did not move after MDM merge process in Engage.
documents.impact: The AFD from Non-Survivor are not moving to Survivor Account.
documents.root_cause: A race condition between Salesforce's internal merge-time reparenting of child records (AFDs) and the asynchronous execution of restoreAccountHelper.restoreAccountFromMerge (Future context).
what_happened: When accounts are merged in MDM, in Engage AFDs are not getting reparented from Non-survivor to Survivor correctly.
Following completion of the MDM merge, AFD records remain linked to the non-survivor accounts.
why_it_happened: restoreAccountHelper.cls runs in the After Delete context of the Account trigger.
A duplicate check is performed on KPMG_Account_Firm_Details__c (AFD) based on Member Firm Code.
If a duplicate AFD is found on the survivor account, the logic reparents it back to the non-survivor account.
summary: In UAT the duplicate-check logic executes before Salesforce reparents the AFD records.
In PROD Salesforce reparents the AFD records before the duplicate-check logic executes, so they are incorrectly treated as duplicates.
proposed_solution: Restructure the duplicate validation so it executes only after Salesforce has completed reparenting child records.
Reparent only the duplicate AFD that originated from the non-survivor account back to the archived non-survivor account.
expected_outcome: Merge behavior remains consistent across UAT and PROD regardless of Salesforce internal reparenting timing.

documents.title: Users are unable to submit OTM removal requests when an automated notification is sent from their unverified email domain.
documents.description: In KPMG Engage, when a user attempts to remove an Opportunity Team Member (OTM) from an Opportunity, the flow "OpportunityTeamApprovalwithCase Flow" fails during execution when the user's email domain is not verified.
documents.expected_result: The Case to request the Team Member removal should be created and notifications sent successfully.
documents.actual_result: The Flow fails with: We can't send your email because your email address domain isn't verified. No OTM request Case is created.
documents.business_impact: none, this is purely a code fix that has no other effect than to fix the issue described.
documents.root_cause: The OTM Removal Alert action is missing the senderType and senderAddress parameters, so Salesforce defaults to the running user's email address, which fails when their domain is not verified.
resolution: Added senderType and senderAddress parameters to the OTM_Removal_Alert action so Salesforce sends the email using an Org-Wide Email Address instead of the running user's email.

solution_items.name: OpportunityTeamApprovalwithCase - Flow
solution_items.change: Added senderType and senderAddress parameters to OTM_Removal_Alert action.

changes: OpportunityTeamApprovalwithCase - FLOW: added Org-Wide Email Address sender configuration to the OTM_Removal_Alert action.
